subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What public memory-core Dream Diary timeout and cleanup contract should maintainers accept for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is credible, but exposing or reshaping `dreaming.execution.*`, changing queue/deadline semantics, and preserving or terminating late output are public plugin behavior choices that should align with the existing timeout/config tracker and open timeout PR.

options.title: Broader narrative contract
options.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Timeout-only first
options.body: Refresh and prove #78440 to wire a configurable timeout, then track queue-time attribution and late-output cleanup as follow-up work.

options.title: Internal no-config fix
options.body: Change wait accounting and timeout cleanup internally while leaving operator-facing Dream Diary controls unchanged.

recommendation.title: Broader narrative contract
recommendation.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and memory-host SDK history makes this the best available routing candidate for the config/runtime contract decision.
